notes.title: On Air - The Winner Unreal Engine DEV Contest 2020 by Disgusting Men
notes.content:
No words could even vaguely describe our feelings about this groundbreaking success, as our team has done a remarkable amount of work on the game.
We have built a number of completely new locations for the game, developed a new AI for the enemies, new in-game content has been modelled. The game story has also been been improved.
In the future, you will be learning even more details and news about the project.
Be sure to add the game to your wishlists, in case you haven“t done so yet. This will be an extremely supportive and encouraging gesture!

Our immense gratitude goes to the contest hosts and its other participants for an enjoyable and memorable event and, last but not the least, - to you, Players, for whom „On Air“ is in the making!
Peace!ːsteamhappyː

notes.content:
